tb21_profile.skill: Infer the algorithm that produced a rendered image and implement a compact C renderer (procedural graphics) that reproduces it to a similarity threshold, under a source-size budget so the answer is algorithmic not data
tb21_profile.domain: Computer graphics / image synthesis (PPM output, path tracing, procedural rendering), numerical C compiled with -lm
tb21_profile.task_form: reverse-engineer-and-reimplement-a-generator, reconstruct-to-a-similarity-target, optimise under a code-size budget

searches: tools.py search all '\.ppm|netpbm|\bP3\b|\bP6\b|ray trac|raytrac|ray-trac|path trac|sphere|camera ray|framebuffer|scanline' -n 40
tools.py search all '\.ppm|ray.?trac|path.?trac|render an image|generate an image|reconstructed|L2 similarity|pixel[- ]by[- ]pixel|writes? an image|fractal|mandelbrot|image.c' -n 40
tools.py search tmax 'image|\.ppm|brightness|pixel|reconstruct|similarity|as close as possible|render' -n 40

tools.py search tmax 'match(es|ing)? (the|our|a) reference|bit-exact|reference implementation|as close as possible|output must match|reconstruct the (model|function|algorithm|transformation)|structural similarity|SSIM' -n 30
tools.py search all 'gzip .*wc|compress.*bytes|smallest.*program|code golf|source .*bytes|under 2k|algorithmic rather than' -n 20
tools.py search rts 'C program|write a C|generate.*(image|png|plot)|similarity|MSE|reproduce.*output|matches the reference|as close|reconstruct the' -n 30

notes: Computer-graphics / path-tracing is essentially absent from all five corpora (regex sweeps for ppm/raytrace/render/framebuffer/mandelbrot returned only container-image, kustomize-render, and figlet noise), so I judged on the two underlying skills: (a) black-box reconstruct a generating process from its output and reimplement it to match (strongly present in TMax as the 'bit-exact to a reference oracle' family), and (b) write numerical C matched to a target within tolerance, with -lm. The honest best 10 are 8/10 TMax; only word_cloud (procedural image generation) and one RTS reverse-the-output-format task earn non-TMax slots. The unique 'gzip < 2k so the solution is algorithmic not embedded data' constraint has essentially no analogue in the pool - I found no code-golf / minimal-program tasks - so no candidate rewards that specific reasoning; the merge step should not expect any corpus to teach the compression/entropy angle. TMax's 'reference implementation / oracle bit-exact' cluster is very large (700+ hits); I picked the ones that force inferring the generator from outputs rather than merely reimplementing a given spec. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench are near-noise for this task and scored 1-2 accordingly.
